_comment: Ashfall overlay. Merged by id over game_data.json (GameData.applyOverlay); VS ids and balance stay as they are. heroes and mainWeapons: design sections 2, 2.1, 2.2 (numbers are starting values to tune). Branch tier mods: a plain key replaces a param, a key ending in Add adds to it (game/MainWeapon). Design: docs/ASHFALL_DESIGN.md section 2, 3, 3.2, 10, 13.

WHIP.name: Vibro Lash
WHIP.description: Horizontal vibro-blade slash that cuts through every enemy in line.

VAMPIRICA.name: Leech Scythe
VAMPIRICA.description: Evolved Vibro Lash. Can crit and drains the wounded to heal you.

MAGIC_MISSILE.name: Spore Dart
MAGIC_MISSILE.description: Launches a spore dart at the nearest enemy.

HOLY_MISSILE.name: Lumen Volley
HOLY_MISSILE.description: Evolved Spore Dart. Fires with no delay.

KNIFE.name: Scalpel Throw
KNIFE.description: Throws scalpels fast in the direction you face.

THOUSAND.name: Scalpel Storm
THOUSAND.description: Evolved Scalpel Throw. Fires with no delay.

AXE.name: Cluster Grenade
AXE.description: Lobs a grenade in an arc. High damage, scales strongly with area.

SCYTHE.name: Shrapnel Spiral
SCYTHE.description: Evolved Cluster Grenade. Spinning shrapnel passes through enemies.

CROSS.name: Ricochet Drone
CROSS.description: A drone that hunts the nearest enemy and boomerangs back.

HEAVENSWORD.name: Strike Wing
HEAVENSWORD.description: Evolved Ricochet Drone. Can deal critical damage.

HOLYBOOK.name: Ward Drones
HOLYBOOK.description: Drones orbit you, shielding and striking whatever they touch.

VESPERS.name: Sentinel Ring
VESPERS.description: Evolved Ward Drones. The ring never ends.

FIREBALL.name: Slag Cannon
FIREBALL.description: Fires molten slag at a random enemy for heavy damage.

HELLFIRE.name: Furnace Burst
HELLFIRE.description: Evolved Slag Cannon. Passes through enemies.

GARLIC.name: Toxic Vent
GARLIC.description: Vents a toxic cloud that damages nearby enemies and weakens their knockback resistance.

VORTEX.name: Lumen Devourer
VORTEX.description: Evolved Toxic Vent. Feeds on the dying; power grows when you recover HP.

HOLYWATER.name: Corrosive Flask
HOLYWATER.description: Throws flasks that leave damaging pools.

BORA.name: Corrosive Wake
BORA.description: Evolved Corrosive Flask. The pools follow you and grow as they move.

LIGHTNING.name: Arc Coil
LIGHTNING.description: Arcs of lightning strike random enemies.

LOOP.name: Tesla Loop
LOOP.description: Evolved Arc Coil. Every strike hits twice.

ARMOR.name: Plate Weave
ARMOR.description: Reduces incoming damage by 1. Increases retaliatory damage by 10%.

AREA.name: Wide-Beam Lens
AREA.description: Augments the area of attacks by 10%.

DURATION.name: Stabilizer Coil
DURATION.description: Increases the duration of weapon effects by 10%.

MAGNET.name: Gravity Collar
MAGNET.description: You pick up items from further away.

CURSE.name: Spore Taint
CURSE.description: Increases enemy speed, health and quantity.

BASTION.name: Bastion
BASTION.description: Hydraulic Hammer swings in a cone and slams every third swing. Tough and slow. Each level: +1% might, +1% max HP.

SPECTRE.name: Spectre
SPECTRE.description: Twin Pistols fire a volley down the aim line. Fragile and fast. Each level: +1% crit chance, +0.5% move speed.

XENOMANT.name: Xenomant
XENOMANT.description: Lumen Caster sends a piercing bolt and a Spore Burst every fourth cast. Each level: +1% area, +1% pickup range.

HAMMER.name: Hydraulic Hammer
HAMMER.description: Cone swing in the aim direction. Every 3rd swing is a Slam: a circle around you that stuns.

tiers.name: Seismic I: Hair Trigger
tiers.desc: Slam every 2nd swing instead of every 3rd.

tiers.name: Seismic II: Fault Line
tiers.desc: Slam also sends a 200-unit shock line (1.0P).

tiers.name: Seismic III: Aftershock
tiers.desc: Slam radius +40%, stun 0.8 s.

tiers.name: Piston Jab I: Thrust
tiers.desc: Every 3rd swing also fires a narrow thrust: 25 deg, range 130, pierces all, 2.5P.

tiers.name: Piston Jab II: Shaped Charge
tiers.desc: Thrust crit chance +25%.

tiers.name: Piston Jab III: Corrosive Tip
tiers.desc: Thrust leaves 3 s of Decay.

tiers.name: Furnace Cleave I: Wide Arc
tiers.desc: Arc 160 deg. Hits apply Burn.

tiers.name: Furnace Cleave II: Fuel Feed
tiers.desc: Burn stacks +1 per hit.

tiers.name: Furnace Cleave III: Flame Wave
tiers.desc: Every swing releases a 60-unit fire wave.

tiers.name: Riot Guard I: Braced
tiers.desc: -15% damage taken for 1 s after a swing.

tiers.name: Riot Guard II: Deflector
tiers.desc: -25% damage taken after a swing. Swings reflect projectiles that cross the cone.

tiers.name: Riot Guard III: Reclaim
tiers.desc: Slam kills heal 1 HP each (max 5 per second).

PISTOLS.name: Twin Pistols
PISTOLS.description: Volley of 3 bullets with a small spread in the aim direction. Crit chance 15%.

tiers.name: Pistol Barrage I: Wide Fan
tiers.desc: 5 bullets per volley, spread 16 deg.

tiers.name: Pistol Barrage II: Hot Barrels
tiers.desc: Interval -20%.

tiers.name: Pistol Barrage III: Starburst
tiers.desc: Every 3rd volley is a full ring of 8.

tiers.name: Piercing Shot I: Heavy Slug
tiers.desc: Replaces the volley with one slug: 3.0P, pierces all, interval 1.5 s.

tiers.name: Piercing Shot II: Tungsten Core
tiers.desc: Crit multiplier x3.0.

tiers.name: Piercing Shot III: Shrapnel End
tiers.desc: The slug explodes at the end of its range (radius 50, 1.5P).

tiers.name: Quick Shot I: Light Trigger
tiers.desc: Interval -25%, but 2 bullets.

tiers.name: Quick Shot II: Steady Aim
tiers.desc: Crit chance +15%.

tiers.name: Quick Shot III: Adrenaline
tiers.desc: Each crit refunds 0.2 s of cooldown.

tiers.name: Cluster Grenade I: Lobber
tiers.desc: Every 4th volley lobs a grenade 220 units: radius 70, 2.0P.

tiers.name: Cluster Grenade II: Bomblets
tiers.desc: The grenade splits into 3 bomblets.

tiers.name: Cluster Grenade III: Incendiary
tiers.desc: Grenades apply Burn and leave a 3 s fire patch.

CASTER.name: Lumen Caster
CASTER.description: A slow lumen bolt that pierces 2 enemies and applies Decay. Every 4th cast is a Spore Burst: a ring of 6 bolts.

tiers.name: Spore Dart I: Seekers
tiers.desc: +2 homing mini-darts per cast, 0.3P each.

tiers.name: Spore Dart II: Barbed
tiers.desc: Darts pierce 1.

tiers.name: Spore Dart III: Venomous
tiers.desc: Darts apply Decay.

tiers.name: Grasping Tendrils I: Snare
tiers.desc: Every 4th cast slams the aim point (max 200 away): roots radius 70 for 1.0 s, 1.0P.

tiers.name: Grasping Tendrils II: Deep Roots
tiers.desc: Radius 100, roots for 1.5 s.

tiers.name: Grasping Tendrils III: Reel In
tiers.desc: Tendrils pull enemies in by 60 units.

tiers.name: Parasite Link I: Tether
tiers.desc: The bolt links two enemies for 3 s: 0.5P per second to both.

tiers.name: Parasite Link II: Siphon
tiers.desc: The link heals you for 2% of the damage it deals.

tiers.name: Parasite Link III: Hopper
tiers.desc: The link jumps to a new target when one end dies.

tiers.name: Wrath of Lumen I: Beam
tiers.desc: The cast becomes a 0.6 s beam (length 260): 0.8P per 0.15 s tick, hits 3.

tiers.name: Wrath of Lumen II: Wide Beam
tiers.desc: Beam width +50% and pierces all.

tiers.name: Wrath of Lumen III: Scorched Ground
tiers.desc: The beam leaves lumen ground for 2 s (Decay).
